about: What the integrator of window 6 (W3.1-bis.9, the descriptions of the catalogue) did by hand, each with its reason, so that window-6-catalogue.js --check holds it like the rest. forced_units: units the gate does not read as Italian that the window still changes (the English paragraphs of the descriptions that declare a limit in another form than the keyword); code_changes: the few changes of code, as a snippet of the tree before the window and what it becomes (before/after, or before_rot13/after_rot13 when the snippet holds Italian: this file is judged by the language gate); overrides: a translation accepted with a flag the translator gave (length_ok, keywords_ok, quoted_ok, protocol_ok), by file and unit; examples: operations whose example changes (a name of the SOLIDWORKS tree, D12). protocol_values: by operation, the values its code takes as they are (read from the code, not from a case of the bench) that a description must keep naming, written in ROT13 (values_rot13: they are Italian, and this file is judged by the language gate); the protocol guard of --apply holds them like the values a case passes.

forced_units.why: descriptions of arguments in Italian that the detector reads as English (lone Italian infinitives with a clitic, «solo con»): fix_component.grounded (translated in the review of the pilot) and the two arguments of the second direction of linear_pattern (they go with the features family). Found by the reader of the blind spots of --check, which lists the catalogue texts the detector passes and that carry Italian function words

code_changes.why: the new contract of the refusal keyword (Tests/RefusalKeywordsContract.cs) is a group of the run like the others; the file is new, and this is the one line that runs it

inspect_part: the example of identifiers listed a name of body that the state never returns (the bodies are C1, C2: DocumentState.cs); a description that teaches a name the operations refuse is worse than none, and the tool refuses a change of reference by design, so the integrator makes it here and says so (the doc comment of the class says the same, and changes with it)

linear_pattern: the description named the second pitch with a stale Italian name of the argument; the argument is pitch2_mm (SwOperations.cs reads it), and a model that wrote the stale name would have the call refused

extrude_section / structural frame, the argument measured_as: the sentence about upper and lower case gave an Italian word as the example of a value that is accepted, but the code matches the catalogue spelling regardless of case (WeldmentOperations.cs, FrameReading) and refuses any other word; the example of a value that works is the English one, «Overall»

slot: the argument of the helper that writes the description of the anchor (it is used as a noun inside the sentence, in capitals and as written) was an Italian noun, a text of the catalogue the translators could not see as a unit of its own, and the other four callers say «the hole», «the boss», «the pocket»

extrude_section (the contour as a circle): the two placeholders of the example name the numbers the model writes there ([x, y] of the center); they are not keys of the protocol and were Italian words inside a JSON shape the tool compares as a placeholder, so it could not change them

create_configuration: the example detail text is free text the model copies, and an Italian example teaches the model to write Italian in a part the owner reads in English (D12); the fix names a left bracket

the fixture of the list of values («a, b or c»): the rule learned «or» in the place of the two Italian words it knew, and the planted sentence is in English

protocol_values.why: MateOperations.cs takes «variant» and «alignment» only as these words (the switch on the variant, the comparison for the opposite alignment); the bench passes four of the six, and a translator that rendered the other two in English would teach the model a value the operation refuses. They leave when the values are renamed (D1/.5) or an exception class is signed (.11)
